headline: For Pakistan's Ismaili muslims, a visit from their spiritual leader brings a homecoming
context: For many Ismaili Muslims, seeing the Aga Khan is a once-in-a-lifetime event. NPR's Betsy Joles reports from his visit to remote northern Pakistan.
